sentences.l2: 地下鉄の電車は、まず工学を学んだ人たちが、どんな形にするかを設計します。
sentences.l1: As for subway trains, first, people who studied engineering design what shape they will have.

sentences.l2: 次に工場で製造します。
sentences.l1: Next, they are manufactured at a factory.

sentences.l2: そして、乗る人が安全に乗れるように、何回も試験をします。
sentences.l1: And then, tests are done many times so that the people who ride can ride safely.
